Lake Depth Contours

Contour lines reconstructed from Maine's official statewide lake-depth sounding survey (Maine DEP / Maine Dept. of Inland Fisheries & Wildlife, digitized "LakeDpth" dataset).

Contours are computed from scattered official depth soundings via triangulated interpolation. Only water bodies with enough well-distributed samples to reconstruct a reliable shape are shown, so some smaller/sparsely-surveyed ponds are omitted. Reference use only, not for navigation.
